businesses.business: Respiratory medical devices and care software

offering_description.value: ResMed designs and manufactures devices for sleep apnea and other breathing disorders. It sells equipment through home medical equipment suppliers and other healthcare channels and provides at-home diagnostic testing. It also sells cloud software to home medical equipment providers, home health and hospice agencies, and long-term care facilities.

primary_products.value: Positive airway pressure devices; respiratory masks and accessories; ventilators; home sleep testing devices; cloud software for home and post-acute care

primary_services.value: At-home sleep and respiratory diagnostic testing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Home medical equipment suppliers, sleep clinics, hospitals, home health and hospice agencies, and long-term care operators; B2C: People buying sleep therapy equipment and supplies; B2G: Public healthcare systems and government-run hospitals

end_markets.value: Sleep medicine; respiratory care; home medical equipment; home health and hospice; long-term care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Therapy devices, masks, replacement supplies and diagnostic equipment; subscription: Cloud software for clinical workflows, billing and care operations; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer payments for eligible home diagnostic tests

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns sourced components and materials into respiratory devices and supplies for equipment providers and healthcare facilities; software / platform: Uses therapy, clinical and billing data in software sold to equipment suppliers and care providers; service provider: Processes home test recordings and reports results to referring clinicians
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Sleep and respiratory therapy devices, home diagnostics, and software for home and post-acute care

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Home medical equipment suppliers and medical device distributors; direct sales: Sales teams serving healthcare organizations and care software customers; online: Company-operated web stores in selected markets; other: Clinician referrals for home diagnostic testing
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; online; other

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA clearance and EU Medical Device Regulation requirements for respiratory and diagnostic devices
